verdict.rationale: Runloop's documented core product is isolated, cloud-hosted Linux sandboxes (Devboxes) where agents run code. Egress network policies limit what that code can reach, and Agent Gateways keep API keys out of the sandbox, so untrusted AI-generated code runs away from the developer's own infrastructure. missing for 10: technical detail on the isolation boundary (e.g., VM/microVM vs container, kernel isolation guarantees), independent or hands-on corroboration of the security claims (all evidence is vendor docs).

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Runloop provides secure sandboxed execution environments called Devboxes.
